reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: It’s a good foaming cleanser. Not sure about its acne fighting benefits as I’ve seen no improvements to my back blemishes
reviews.zh: 這是一支唔錯嘅泡沫潔面乳。對佢嘅抗暗瘡功效就唔太確定，因為我背部嘅瑕疵完全冇改善過。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: This body cleanser is effective for acne-prone and rough skin. It cleanses thoroughly without drying out the skin. I use it every other day, and with continued use, I feel my skin has become softer and I no longer feel roughness because its ingredients help with gentle exfoliation. I also use it with a heavy body cream.
reviews.zh: 呢款身體清潔液對暗瘡肌同粗糙皮膚都好有效。佢清潔得好徹底，但又唔會令皮膚變乾。我隔日用一次，持續用落去，覺得皮膚變得柔軟咗，亦再感覺唔到粗糙，因為佢嘅成分有助溫和去角質。我會配搭一款厚重嘅身體乳一齊用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: A practical body cleanser for areas prone to breakouts, especially the back and chest. It leaves the skin feeling clean without being too harsh. I would not call it an instant solution, but with consistent use it feels like a good supporting product for smoother and clearer body skin. I would repurchase it as part of a body acne routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款身體清潔液好實用，適合容易爆瘡嘅部位，尤其係背部同胸口。佢洗完之後皮膚感覺乾淨，但又唔會太過刺激。我唔會話佢係即時見效嘅產品，但持續用落去，感覺係一款唔錯嘅輔助品，可以令身體皮膚更滑更清。我會將佢納入身體暗瘡護理流程再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: You guys, I’ve been loving the SOME BY MI AHA-BHA-PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser! 😍 It seriously transformed my skin — it feels so smooth, clean, and less bumpy after just a few uses. The exfoliating blend is powerful but gentle, and it helps keep stubborn bumps and breakouts on my body under control without drying me out. Plus, it lathers really nicely and smells so fresh! 💦✨ If you struggle with body acne or texture, this is such a game changer!
reviews.zh: 各位，我好鍾意呢款 SOME BY MI AHA-BHA-PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser！😍 佢真係徹底改變咗我嘅皮膚——只係用咗幾次，皮膚就變得好滑、好乾淨，粒粒都減少咗。佢嘅去角質配方功效強勁但又溫和，可以控制身上嘅頑固粒粒同暗瘡，但又唔會令皮膚變乾。而且，佢起泡效果好好，聞落好清新！💦✨ 如果你受身體暗瘡或者膚質問題困擾，呢款真係必買推介！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: Tengo poco menos de un mes de estarla usando porque tengo hiperpigmentacion en los brazos. Creo que me está ayudando pero parece que va un poco más lento de lo que esperaba. En el mes que llevo ha bajado muy poquito el nivel, así que tengo esperanza de ver resultados en un poco más de tiempo. Huele muy bonito.
reviews.zh: 我用咗差唔多一個月，因為手臂有色素沉澱。我覺得佢有幫助，但效果好似比我預期嘅慢少少。用咗呢個月，色素淡咗好少，所以我有期望再過多一段時間會見到效果。味道好香。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: Bought this to fight my acne on the back, but I think you can use it twice a week for a whole body for exfoliating purposes. Smells like sth with acids. 😅 You might wanna use it before you go to bed, not before you go out 😂 , depends on how much you care about your perfume. I think this smell will fight your normal perfume.
reviews.zh: 買呢支係為咗對付背部暗瘡，但我覺得可以用佢每星期兩次，幫全身去角質。聞落有啲似含酸類產品嘅味道。😅 你最好喺瞓覺前用，唔好出街前用 😂 ，要視乎你有幾在意自己嘅香水。我覺得呢個味道會同你平時嘅香水打架。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text:
i finally have smooth skin on my arms! 
At first i was sceptical, bought this instead of the viral BRMud. 
But after using this SOME product for almost a month (2 times a week) i find that my skin is softer, smoother and the keratosis pilaris i had is pretty much totally gone 😳 
In my opinion my skin absorbs lotion better after using this and keeps hydrated longer. 
Unfortunaly i dont have a before picture.. but I posted an after use for a month picture :)
reviews.zh:
我手臂終於變得滑溜啦！
一開始我半信半疑，買咗呢支而唔係當時大熱嘅 BRMud。
但用咗呢款 SOME 嘅產品差唔多一個月（一星期兩次）之後，發現皮膚變得柔軟同滑，仲有我之前嘅毛囊角化都幾乎完全消失晒 😳
我覺得用完呢個之後，皮膚吸收乳液嘅效果更好，仲可以keep住更長時間嘅保濕。
可惜我冇before嘅相……但我post咗一張用咗一個月嘅after相 :)

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Body Cleanser 400g
reviews.text: I've been using this for a few days and i can already tell there is a huge difference in my textured and acne on my chest.. as a kid, i used to always have "bumpy" looking skin on my chest & back along with pimples, and i never was able to calm them down or get rid of them until i got this product-- it didn't get rid of the pimples completely, but they rarely appear & my skin feels smoother. there is no scent
reviews.zh: 我用咗幾日，已經可以明顯見到我胸口嘅膚質同暗瘡有重大改善……細個嗰陣，我胸口同背部成日都有「粒粒」嘅皮膚，仲會生暗瘡，一直以嚟都冇辦法舒緩或者清除佢哋，直到我用到呢款產品——雖然佢未至於完全清除暗瘡，但暗瘡好少再出，皮膚亦都感覺更滑。冇任何味道。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
